items.summary: Fiserv (NasdaqGS:FISV) has appointed Raj Seshadri, a former senior executive at Mastercard, to its Board of Directors. Seshadri brings experience leading commercial payments and data-focused businesses, alongside prior leadership roles at BlackRock and other financial institutions. Her background aligns with Fiserv's focus on unified commerce and embedded fintech as the board continues to evolve its mix of skills. items.title: Mastercard Is “One of the Greatest Businesses in the World,” Says Bill Ackman. Do the Estimates Agree?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBill Ackman said on CNBC on Tuesday that he picked up Visa (V:NYSE) and Mastercard (MA:NYSE) in the low 20s times earnings, and he called them a royalty on consumer spending. Analysts expect Mastercard’s normalized EPS to grow about 16% a year from 2026 to 2028, faster than the roughly 14% a year they expect from Visa.
